verdict.line: You lose extended 1v1s from level 3 once Riposte and her Duelist stacks come online, but you win the short, banked-Grit all-ins before then.

brief.thesis: Sett's W passively banks the damage Fiora's aggressive Lunge (Q) pokes deal into him as Grit, so her early poke directly fuels his true-damage nuke — but her Duelist passive heals on every hit she lands and stacks per champion, so any fight that drags past the first exchange starts favoring her sustain instead of yours. That tension between short trades (yours) and long duels (hers) is why Sett actually holds a lane-advantage read on OP.GG but only converts 44.4% of 117 games.

theirWindow.what: Don't throw your Q-empowered right punch or an engage auto into a live Riposte — it parries the next basic attack and blocks the damage outright, wasting the trade you were banking Grit for.

yourWindow.what: The instant her W is on cooldown (10s down to 6s at rank 5), all-in with Q's empowered autos into E for the pull — there's nothing left to eat your damage.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through repeated short trades and heals you back, directly contesting the sustain race her Duelist passive is trying to win.

playing.title: Bank Grit off her Lunge
playing.detail: Sett's W passively stores damage taken as Grit; let her first Lunge (Q) land if it's not lethal, then cash it in as a shield plus true-damage punch the moment she closes.

playing.title: Track her Riposte cooldown
playing.detail: Riposte parries your next basic attack and blocks it outright. Never send your Q-empowered right punch in on a fresh W — wait for the 10-6s cooldown to expire first.

playing.title: Sandwich her with minions for E
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns when enemies are on opposite sides of you; with nothing on the far side it just slows. Walk her onto the opposite side of a minion before casting E.

playing.title: Punish a single-dash Lunge
playing.detail: Her Q can recast for free within a couple seconds. If she only gets one dash off, whiffed or spent, that's your window to Q in and start the true-damage W.

playing.title: Trade R for R at level 6
playing.detail: Blade Waltz hits repeatedly with falling damage per hit and a 130s cooldown at rank 1. Your Show Stopper isn't a basic attack, so Riposte can't stop it — meet her all-in with your own.

playing.title: Avoid chain-fighting her stacks
playing.detail: Duelist heals her on every instance of damage and stacks per champion hit. Short burst trades beat drawn-out skirmishes where her sustain snowballs.

playing.title: Shred her sustain late
playing.detail: Pick up Executioner's Calling once she's ahead or the fight length is working against you — it directly cuts the healing keeping her in duels.

brief.patchCaveat: Every build path, rune page, and win-rate number above is measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reasoning — Grit banking off her Lunge, Riposte timing, Facebreaker's stun condition — is our own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Focus on avoiding Fiora’s (W) when using your abilities. Purchase Bramble Vest and be careful of her (P) when fighting her.
